watch.name: 伊戈尔
watch.reason: Attractive/weak pre-signal momentum does not repair the missing proof that the company's pre-cutoff product/customer set matches the U.S. utility distribution-transformer bottleneck.

decisions.reason: HBM bottleneck is strong, but no uncontaminated A-share company had sufficiently direct HBM-specific qualified shipment/order evidence and material earnings exposure at the cutoff.

Direct upstream copper production with already-ramped TFM/KFM capacity maps cleanly to concentrate scarcity. Recent price strength is acknowledged but is not an automatic veto because the physical supply squeeze escalated at the cutoff.

rule: Only the frozen Candidate basket may have post-signal prices opened. Watch futures remain unopened. No later candidate substitution is allowed.
